stories.title: 7.7 earthquake off Indonesia triggers tsunami warning
new_facts: New story: 7.7-magnitude earthquake off Flores Island, Indonesia, early Saturday; one dead.
Quake damaged buildings and sent residents to higher ground, indicating tsunami risk response.
Death toll raised to at least two; buildings toppled; region described as quake-prone.
Quake occurred around 5 a.m. local time at ~6-mile depth; no major tsunami generated.
New story: 7.7 magnitude earthquake strikes Indonesia, tsunami warning issued, no immediate damage/casualty reports
Quake pinpointed off Flores island; followed by at least two aftershocks
Adds depth (10km), time (5:58am Saturday), aftershock magnitude 6.1, hundreds evacuated
Indonesia's geophysics agency puts magnitude at 7.8, says no threat to Australia
stories.line: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck off Indonesia's coast, triggering a tsunami warning.

stories.title: FDA recalls 19 million eggs over salmonella contamination
new_facts: FDA recalls 19 million eggs over Salmonella risk, warning of severe illness or death from exposure.
FDA assigns Class I (highest-risk) status to a July egg recall of 1.5 million eggs over salmonella.
NYT quotes FDA's Class I classification language: 'reasonable probability' of 'serious adverse health consequences or death.'
stories.line: FDA recalls millions of eggs from a producer due to salmonella contamination risk.

new_facts: Builders in Belgium found hidden gold treasure worth £7.5million in a cellar renovation.
Workers found $10 million in gold coins/bars while building a sewer under a former brewery in Belgium.
stories.line: Construction workers in Britain discovered gold worth roughly £7.5 million while renovating a cellar beneath a former brewery.
